title: 6.4.2 Sub-build: A pocket you roll over
description: A ball, a hole, and the speed test. No table, no rules yet.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The ball slides across the hole and bounces off it: the hole is solid.

steps.title: Make it pass-through
steps.instructions: Set `pocket.collider = 'none';` in `setup()`. Now the ball rolls over it.

steps.title: Drop only a slow ball
steps.instructions: When `ball.overlaps(pocket)` and `ball.speed < 1`, stop the ball, put it in the hole, and set a flag so it only happens once.
hints: `overlaps()` is true every frame; without a guard the drop runs 60 times a second.
The speed test is what lets a hard shot roll over.

requirements.title: The pocket is pass-through
requirements.description: The pocket sprite has collider = 'none'. Help: 6.4.1 (Reading: A pocket you roll over)

requirements.title: A slow ball drops, once
requirements.description: Overlap plus a speed test, guarded so it happens once. Help: 6.4.1 (Reading: A pocket you roll over)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Sub-build: A pocket you roll over". The task: make a pass-through pocket and drop the ball only when it overlaps it slowly, guarded so it happens once. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.

rubric.title: Slow only
rubric.description: The drop requires a speed under a small number.

rubric.title: Once
rubric.description: A flag, a moved ball or a delete stops it repeating every frame.
